main_text.l: Hic Latiis clarus, Graiys ast ille Camœnis,
Quis te maiorem sanus vtroque neget?
In Coniugium Impar.
Plaudite, nam vetula iuuenem sors æqua maritat:
Ille etenim vetula est dignus, vt hæc vitulo.
IN GALLVM QVI SVBIN-
DE RATIONEM ORNANDI
capitis mutat.
QVVM toties barbā atq; comā, mutétq; Galeros,
Vnū quis Gallo dixerit esse caput?
Ad Zoilos.
Beʒanostra placent: vatum celeberrimus ille est
Nil mihi nunc tecum linida turba. vale.
IN QVENDAM MA-
ledicum.
ME furem vocitas, plagiỹ quoque crime
inuris, Et versus quereris surripuisse tuos.
Sed me tunde, licet, Cumano peius asello,
Si cuiquam vates crederis esse bonus.
ALIVD.
Qui meos blateras nitere versus
I. j.

page.notes: Mixed printing: the poem titles are set in small capitals. Some letters are doubtful, e.g. "Beʒa" in "Beza nostra" is a printed ligature/initial that I could not read with certainty; "linida" and "mutétq;" are as printed but uncertain. "Galeros" and "Ad Zoilos." are as printed. The head "IN QVENDAM MA-ledicum." is a title split over a line end with a printed hyphen. The stanza ornament and rules are not text and are omitted. Bottom "I. j." is a printed mark kept as a paragraph.
